en.text:
Grants an additional <strand/>Frenzied Blade Ability Charge.

<strand/>Frenzied Blade or <strand/>Flechette Storm Hits grant a Stack of 'Wish-Dragon's Talons' for 2.75 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Can only grant 1 Stack per ability usage.

'Wish-Dragon's Talons' grants 25%|60%|120% increased <strand/>Frenzied Blade and <strand/>Flechette Storm damage at 1|2|3 stacks.

<strand/>Banner of War's Pulses grant 5% <strand/>Frenzied Blade Ability Energy and an additional 5% for each ally within 10 meters.
